text:
maya: Quick sync — customers are asking for a clear Optimize toolkit launch plan. Need to agree MVP scope + launch gates for batching, caching, quant recommendations, and eval-triggered alerts. Root ask: what do we ship vs defer?
kevin: TL;DR lab batching results look good (2-3x throughput). KV prefix cache needs infra work for per-tenant isolation. Quant recs are heavier (model matrix + test harness).
sarah: From CS: AcmeHealth + FinEdge want quant recs + eval alerts before pilot. Their acceptance: false positive alert rate < 5% and a migration guide. They'll only pilot if we can promise those.
leo: Eng-runtime callouts: we need metrics emitted: tokens_saved, batch_size_distribution, cache_hit_rate. Perf gate: p95 latency should not regress >15% vs baseline when caching enabled. Also want canary rollout plan.
anya: Product proposal for gating: 1) Pilot with 2 paying customers 2) Eval-alert CI integration (sample set + baseline) 3) Benchmarks: median latency <= 1.2x and throughput gains >= 1.8x for batching 4) Docs + migration guide available.
kevin: Technical nuance: for quant recs, we should ship "recommendations only" — no automatic model conversion in MVP. Recs include compatibility matrix and expected quality delta. Runtime fallback to FP16/FP32 must be trivial.
maya: I'm inclined to trim scope: drop per-model auto-quant profiles from MVP, include a recommendations API + dashboard, adaptive batching + prefix caching, and a simple eval-alert rule engine (threshold alerts + basic regression diffing). 6 week target if we focus.
leo: Sounds reasonable. Actionable infra items: 
- add cache namespace isolation (owner: leo, ETA 3w)
- telemetry plumbing for tokens_saved and cache_hit_rate (owner: kevin, ETA 2w)
- canary routing by customer flag (owner: kevin, ETA 2w)
kevin: Also need a lightweight eval runner for compare jobs — suggest a cron job that runs N=200 samples against baseline and candidate when a model rec is created. Sample config snippet: ```json
{"eval_samples":200, "metrics":["rougeL","embedding_cos_sim"], "alert_thresholds":{"rougeL":-0.05}}
```
sarah: Legal/Compliance note from AcmeHealth: they need retention + audit log wording for eval artifacts. Requesting security review.
anya: Ok gate checklist (proposal):
- Pilot customers signed (2)
- Eval-alert CI + sample harness integrated
- Performance benchmarks met (median latency <= 1.2x, batching throughput >= 1.8x)
- Docs: quickstart + migration guide
- Security signoff on eval artifacts retention
If all pass -> green for pilot.
maya: Prioritization: MVP backlog order -> 1) adaptive batching heuristics and ops controls 2) prefix/KV caching with tenant isolation 3) recommendations API + dashboard 4) eval-alerts basic engine 5) advanced quant profiles (deferred).
leo: Can we define acceptance metrics for each item? Quick pass: 
- batching: sample workloads show >=1.8x throughput and stable p95 <= +15%
- cache: cache_hit_rate >= 30% on prefix-heavy workloads and tokens_saved metric reported
- recs API: number of recs surfaced + acceptance rate in pilot
- eval-alerts: false-positive rate < 5% in pilot + time-to-detect regression < 24h
kevin: Implementation note: recommend we ship endpoints as opt-in flags per-customer so we avoid noisy cross-tenant effects. Also keep quant recs read-only in first ship.
sarah: I'll surface the gating checklist to AcmeHealth and ask for pilot commitment if we meet those targets.
deploy-bot: scheduled: /deploy optimize-toolkit-canary to prod-cust-flag at 2024-06-18T22:00Z :rocket:
anya: Next steps: 1) owners agree to ETAs above 2) schedule 30m decision meeting Monday 3pm PT 3) I’ll draft the pilot gating doc and share a short PR for review.
maya: Thanks — signing off with the final negotiation: we push advanced quant profiles to post-pilot; everything else in MVP if infra telemetry + eval alerts land on time. Please add any objections to the meeting agenda. :thumbsup:
